subject: Vinicius admits poor preparation after the World Cup; Mourinho says he shouldn't have said it but values honesty
title: Vinicius blames the World Cup. Mourinho disagrees.

lines.vo: Vinicius blames his slow start on the World Cup. Mourinho disagrees.
lines.footage: Vinicius press conference clip, Singapore, close-up

lines.vo: Real Madrid's winger has one league goal in eight games. He lost his starting place to new signing Yan Diomande.
lines.footage: Real Madrid bench shot, Vinicius sitting, then a pitch shot

lines.vo: In Singapore he said he trained less after the tournament. He felt overwhelmed by summer transfer talk. Honest, at least.
lines.footage: Vinicius training session clip, Real Madrid ground

lines.vo: Mourinho said he should not have said it. But he does not criticise honesty.
lines.footage: Mourinho press conference clip, arms folded

lines.vo: His message is simple: win your place back. The honesty gets a thumbs up. The excuse does not.
lines.footage: Vinicius dribbling clip, Real Madrid home match

lines.vo: Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

facts_used: Vinicius said at a Singapore press conference on 16 November that he trained less after the World Cup and felt overwhelmed by summer transfer talk (news id 13, espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50539637)
Vinicius has one LaLiga goal in eight games and lost his starting spot to new signing Yan Diomande (news id 13)
Mourinho said Vinicius shouldn't have said it, does not criticise honesty, and told him to win back his place (news id 13)
notes: Non-comic, so no inserts. Quotes are paraphrased. The red card and ban are not used as joke material. The joke rests on the honesty and the one-goal-in-eight stat. Real Madrid versus Celta Vigo timing not stated in the script.
